  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

  --nms NMS

  --cam-h CAM_H
  --no-display
  --save-dir SAVE_DIR
  --save-interval SAVE_INTERVAL
                        save fresh results every N seconds
  --alarm-beep
  --duration DURATION   stop after N seconds, 0 runs continuously
  --replay-fps REPLAY_FPS
                        controlled image/video replay rate
  --result-ttl RESULT_TTL
                        maximum capture-to-output age in seconds

  --alarm-dwell ALARM_DWELL
  --alarm-cooldown ALARM_COOLDOWN
  --alarm-clear ALARM_CLEAR
  --audio-timeout AUDIO_TIMEOUT
  --jsonl JSONL         exclusive per-frame JSONL output path
  --session-json SESSION_JSON
                        session counters, quantiles and runtime samples
  --stats-window STATS_WINDOW
  --sample-interval SAMPLE_INTERVAL
  --web-host WEB_HOST   preview bind address; LAN use 0.0.0.0
  --web-port WEB_PORT   HTTP preview port, 0 disables
  --clip-dir CLIP_DIR   event clips and coverage metadata directory
  --clip-pre CLIP_PRE
  --clip-post CLIP_POST
  --clip-fps CLIP_FPS
  --clip-encoder {opencv,mpp}
